accepted-scope: Static browser app with accessible add, completion, deletion and localStorage reload persistence.
accepted_values.boundary-clarifications: Source remains repo://workspace-prototype-studio/prototypes.yaml; maturity does not grant Delivery, runtime, Security, source-custody, or publication authority.
excluded-scope: No accounts, backend storage, external APIs, client-sensitive data, public hosting or new AI authoring.
accepted_values.expected-proof: In owner Preview, add, complete and delete synthetic tasks; reload retains changes. Deliver the same reviewed app to its reserved owner repository. (demonstration)
accepted_values.open-issue-disposition: No visible issue blocks this maturity decision.
accepted_values.prototype-objective: Qualify a simple to-do app for individual daily tasks: add, complete, delete and reload with browser-local persistence, then carry the reviewed prototype through Console-managed Delivery.
